notes.title: The Game Expo
notes.content:
Rita is heading to The Game Expo ([url=https://www.thegameexpo.com/]https://www.thegameexpo.com/[/url]) in Melbourne on 22-23 March 2025!

Come say hello and play the new demo, featuring:
[list]
[*] Full controller support - sit back and relax
[*] Brand new dynamic sound track
[*] Store and lore behind the mysterious "memory worlds"
[*] New puzzles to solve
[/list]
As well as Postcards to collect, SporkTank Puzzle of the Day, Mini 3D Ritas, and a Life-sized Rita!

See you there! 🐤🧩🧡
